context_compaction.note: Blog says the session log lives outside the context window and that transformations are left to the harness; compaction/trimming are described as prior work, not as Managed Agents defaults.

tool_schema_source.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands
tool_schema_source.note: Only MCP is stated as a schema source; the source of the built-in tool schemas is not reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Claude calls MCP tools via a dedicated proxy
protocol_standardization.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a harness (the loop that calls Claude and routes Claude’s tool calls to the relevant infrastructure)
loop_primitives.note: event_driven is inferred from the event-log description (emitEvent/getEvents).

multi_agent_topology.note: The blog says brains can pass hands to one another, but it does not describe the default topology.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: a session (the append-only log of everything that happened)
short_term_state.note: The session is an event log stored outside the context window. It is a closest-value fit.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the memory tool lets Claude write context to files, enabling learning across sessions
long_term_memory.evidence_locator: paper Sec. The session is not Claude’s context window
long_term_memory.note: The memory tool is described as prior context-engineering work; the blog does not confirm it is part of Managed Agents' default configuration.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: a new one can be rebooted with wake(sessionId), use getSession(id) to get back the event log, and resume from the last event
state_persistence.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands

retry_policy.note: Container re-provisioning on tool error is decided by Claude. That is not task-level retry.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: including context organization to achieve a high prompt cache hit rate
cost_controls.evidence_locator: paper Sec. The session is not Claude’s context window

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: If the container died, the harness caught the failure as a tool-call error and passed it back to Claude.
execution_isolation.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands
execution_isolation.note: The harness runs remotely and sandboxes are pluggable (container, phone, emulator).

network_policy.note: The blog describes credentials being isolated from the sandbox but gives no egress policy.

tracing.evidence_quote: the harness writes to the session with emitEvent(id, event) in order to keep a durable record of events
tracing.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands

replayability.evidence_quote: rewinding a few events before a specific moment to see the lead up, or rereading context before a specific action
replayability.evidence_locator: paper Sec. The session is not Claude’s context window

guardrails.note: The blog describes credential isolation (tokens kept in a vault outside the sandbox). This does not fit input/output/action filters.
